info.title: archer's desk
info.description: Everything on an archer's desk account: screens and their pages, cards, set times, location, alarms, calendars, world clocks and accounts. Each tool is also an MCP tool at /api/mcp (Streamable HTTP). Authenticate with a desk token from settings → MCP; its scopes decide which operations it can call and it may be limited to some screens.

tags.name: read
tags.description: See screens, pages, alarms, calendars and which accounts are set up. Never secrets.

tags.name: screens
tags.description: Pages, cards, set times, location, away and each screen's own options.

tags.name: calendars
tags.description: Add, change and remove calendar feeds.

tags.name: accounts
tags.description: Set the usernames, addresses and keys widgets sign in with. Keys can be written, never read back.

post.description:
Start here. The account, its screens (each with its pages in order), units, world clocks, how many alarms and calendars there are, which accounts are set up, and what this token may do.

Needs the `read` scope.

200.description: Done. `result` is what the matching MCP tool returns.

400.description: Something about the request needs fixing; `error` says what.

401.description: No token, or one that's been revoked.

403.description: The token doesn't have this scope, or the screen is outside the ones it's limited to.

post.description:
Add a page to a screen, optionally named and filled with rows. It goes at the end unless position says where (1 = first after Standby). Set times pointing at pages after it follow them along.

Needs the `screens` scope.

name.description: What the page is called, like "Phantom".

items.description: A row: two square cards side by side ({left, right}) or one wide card ({wide}).

left.description: A widget; list_widgets describes them all.

right.description: A widget; list_widgets describes them all.

wide.description: A widget; list_widgets describes them all.

rows.description: Its rows, top to bottom. Defaults to one row: clock and calendar.

position.description: Where it goes among the pages. Defaults to the end.

post.description:
Make a screen turn to a page at a time: every day, on some days, or just once on a date. With stay_minutes it goes back to what it was showing afterwards (unless someone touched it); without, it stays until touched. E.g. "16:15 on tue → Phantom for 60 minutes".

Needs the `screens` scope.

screen.description: The screen's name or id. Can be left out when the token (or the account) has just one screen.

at.description: A 24-hour time on the screen's own clock, like "16:15".

show.description: "standby", "pad", or a page by number or name.

days.description: The days it repeats on. Empty or left out means every day.

date.description: Just once, on this date ("2026-10-22"), instead of repeating. null makes it repeat again.

stay_minutes.description: How long it stays; 0 or left out = until touched.

200.description: Done. `result` is what the matching MCP tool returns.

400.description: Something about the request needs fixing; `error` says what.

401.description: No token, or one that's been revoked.

403.description: The token doesn't have this scope, or the screen is outside the ones it's limited to.
